single.rationale: Federal Signal shows exceptional momentum with 17% revenue growth, expanding margins (operating margin up to 15.6% from 15.1%), and strong cash generation (FCF $227M). The company is executing well across acquisitions, organic growth, and operational efficiency, with record orders ($2.22B) and robust backlog ($1.04B) supporting visibility into 2026. While valuation appears full at 27x P/E, the consistent operational excellence and favorable market positioning warrant deeper analysis.
